status: explicit private-output observed-membership foundation; native execution acceptance pending

target.owner: live PrivateRoot and its retained ReadDirectory parent lease

explicit.operation: caller explicitly invokes standalone membership::verify_membership; existing identity/security API and mutations do not imply membership checking

enumeration.restart_scan: first call for each directory only
enumeration.eof: STATUS_NO_MORE_FILES only; NTSTATUS and IO_STATUS_BLOCK agree and Information is zero
enumeration.success: complete one-entry framing; zero-byte success, overflow/truncation, unexpected status or malformed record fail
enumeration.concurrency: Microsoft documents that changes during multiple calls may or may not be observed; not an atomic namespace snapshot
enumeration.framing: 80-byte fixed header plus up to 255 UTF16 units (590 bytes); exact extent or opaque ignored alignment padding through 8-byte alignment of at most 7 bytes

membership.scope: complete observed direct children of every owned directory, compared with current same-owner entries
membership.names: exact current names, including post-rename parents/names; dot entries are framing exceptions, not adopted children
membership.identity: enumerated FileId, file/directory type and no-reparse observations match current owned entries; held/named admitted attributes are checked separately by root guards; NTFS FileIndex is ignored
membership.unknown: fatal; never recursively traverse or adopt an unknown directory
membership.dots: optional filesystem-supplied dot records; if supplied require unique occurrence, directory type and current/self or owned/external-parent FileId; excluded from children but charged to admitted records

guards.root: existing root/parent identity, attributes, process SID, DACL, case-sensitivity and permanent invalidation checks before and after
guards.directory: transient complete directory snapshots for all owned directories captured before and compared after the scan
guards.failure: observed scan/guard failure permanently poisons owner even after repair

limits.scope: global counters for the complete pass; original output ceilings remain; not RSS, all CPU or physical reservation; repeated passes need caller budgeting
limits.records_scope: admitted/decoded records including dot entries, not every native returned record on failure
limits.record_cap_lookahead: at the admitted record cap, one query lookahead charged to global query_calls can establish EOF; a returned data record rejects Budget without decoding and permanently poisons, so a failing pass may receive one extra native record; successful passes never exceed admitted-record cap
limits.invalid_arguments: zero or above-cap Limits reject before filesystem I/O without poisoning the root
limits.query_calls_scope: NtQueryDirectoryFile calls only; existing root guard I/O is separate

validation.contract_tests: static source/contract/workflow consistency only; not native execution evidence
validation.count_policy: exact listed contract inventory and executed count; zero selected or ignored cases fail
validation.historical_output: fourteen ordinary output cases belong to a220596 native CI4; later 5ce8b83 is documentary; no membership acceptance inferred
validation.native_requirement: actual Windows x86_64 fixed local NTFS; Wine and cross-compilation are insufficient
validation.case_scope: 13 real temporary-NTFS fixture cases and 11 pure decoder/matcher/status/limit cases, all selected on native Windows; source inventory is not execution evidence

not_claimed: atomic filesystem snapshot or detection of every transient concurrent mutation
private namespace against same SID or administrator
Windows restart recovery or crash durability
new Linux/Windows bundle or source-profile relabel
